scope: All Qwen RMSNorm modules use the frozen kernel on eligible single-token decode inputs. Original prefill, independent fresh cache per trial. Includes model, LM head, growing cache and argmax; fixed steps after EOS. Default mode requires strict logits/token and baseline-repeat checks. Explicit exploratory mode retains failed logits and requires all local checks. Uncompiled original model baseline; no attention or GEMV replacement.

cases.prompt: Explain why the sky appears blue in one sentence.
